assessment.scope: Selected ILCD 2011 (§3.11.6–§3.11.9), JRC109369 (unnumbered front leaves, p. 4 author page, §4.10), JRC130796 (§§1–2, Table 1), ten CRC32/HTTP-206 verified official EF 3.1 XML members (b2ad6110, b2ad6494, six energy-carrier flows, 93a60a56 Net calorific value, 93a60a57 Units of energy), Van Oers et al. 2020 uranium boundary passages + ESM1 OOXML (characterisation model!C10–C30, recommended ADP & norm data!I109), and original RIVM 2016-0104 Chapter 13 / §24 + Chapter 12 / §23.1 uranium row.
assessment.comparison: Separates geological stock scarcity (ILCD 2011 rejection of constant unit exergy; combined Sb-eq ADP) from full-substitution energy-carrier midpoints (EF 1 MJ/MJ net calorific value vs ReCiPe FFP HHV_x/HHV_oil in kg oil-eq). Establishes conditional LHV-vs-HHV correspondence across five fossil fuels, the cross-category shift of natural uranium (EF Resource use, fossils 6th flow vs elemental ADP and mineral SOP), and why equal 1 kg oil-eq midpoint extractions diverge >5.6x in endpoint SCP (0.457 vs ~0.358 vs ~0.081 USD2013) while the egalitarian per-kg hard-coal proxy places brown coal/peat (~0.155 USD2013) at ~1.9x equal-energy hard coal.
assessment.values: Fourteen ev-fossil117-* records bind 31 structured numeric facts with exact raw decimal fidelity (including full 17-digit OOXML cached uranium ADP 0.0078231761897435744 kg Sb eq/kg) and BigInt fixed-point verification of both rounded Table 13.1/13.2 ratios and unrounded Table S9.1 HHV controls.
assessment.limits: Preserves RIVM p. 96 cross-table/figure misreferences (Table S9.2 for S9.1, Figure 11.2 for 13.2), attribution of the log-linear fossil cost formula to the mineral SOP paper Vieira et al. 2016b (p. 117), unclosed billion-barrel vs kg abscissa (40.0 - 4.45 ln(1.61e14) ≈ -105.6), hard coal CFE = n.a., USD2008 vs USD2013 labels, unobtained Vieira & Huijbregts (in preparation) / IEA 2013 curves, and EF 3.1 XML shortDescription Radioactivity legacy strings.
assessment.correction: All 935 pre-#115 claims (including Note 1 opening correction) and nine #115 mineral claims remain byte-for-byte unchanged; only cl-mineral115-judgment (Note 33) receives an explicit dated three-example sync with ev-fossil117-rivm-scp-endpoint.
assessment.review: Two-round independent primary-source/numeric audit verified every carrier hash, page/cell locator, author credit (Edward Diaconu), citation mapping and calculation. Agent source verification does not claim human expert certification, desktop spreadsheet recalculation, or empirical fuel-market forecasting.
